rules.requirement: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The 1st Outsider this kills becomes an evil Fang Gu & you die instead. [+1 Outsider]

assertingTests.name: a first Outsider death makes the Outsider the new Fang Gu and kills the old Demon (SNV-FANGGU-01)
a protected Outsider does not become the new Fang Gu (SNV-FANGGU-01, BMR-TEALADY-01)
the four Sects & Violets Demons have a step from the second night, choosing one player (SNV-FANGGU-01, SNV-NODASHII-01, SNV-VIGORMORTIS-01, SNV-VORTOX-01)
a Sects & Violets Demon's step changes nothing but the step, and the host's death on its outcome is a Demon death (SNV-FANGGU-01, SNV-NODASHII-01, SNV-VIGORMORTIS-01, SNV-VORTOX-01)
the Outsider the Fang Gu jumps into wakes as the Fang Gu from the next night (SNV-FANGGU-01)
the Fang Gu's step resolves to nothing, healthy or impaired: the host marks the death on the outcome (SNV-FANGGU-01, SNV-FANGGU-04)
